player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: A via ciqoma na dauqito e dua na veisau ni sega vua na ivukevuke me cakava kina.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Ivalavala ca. Column {col} e vu mai na kena isau.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Ivalavala ca. Column {col} e tini.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: A tovolea na dauqito {player_id} me solia e dua na isolisoli ni veivoli ka sega vua na ivurevure gadrevi.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Player {player_id} a vakatutu na kerekere ena fomu e sega ni dodonu.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Sega ni dua na nona vakatutu vou o koya e qito {player_id}.

offers.reject: E sega ni ciqoma na dauqito {player_id} na nona soli me veisau.
offers.accept: Na Player {acceptor_id} a vakadonuya na i vakatutu ni veivakatorocaketaki mai na Player {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} e tukuna na tukinivolavola oqo ki Player {opponent_id}: Ivolavola ni kena: {offered} -> Kena ivakaraitaki: {requested}

outcome.win: Na dauqito {winner_id} qaqa ena kena tubu vakalevu cake na iyau ni ivotavota.
outcome.draw: Na veisau vata ga ena iwiliwili ni iyaya e tu vei ira kece na dauqito.
